Reference / crypto/password

crypto/password#

Password storage with Argon2id (RFC 9106) in PHC string format.

Version: v1.0.0

Synopsis#

let stored = PasswordHash(password, Argon2Policy(), SystemEntropy()).string();
PasswordCheck(stored, attempt).matches(); // constant-time verification

Description#

Password storage with Argon2id (RFC 9106) in PHC string format.

Argon2Policy() is the OWASP baseline (19 MiB, 2 iterations, 1 lane); Argon2Policy(memory_kib, iterations, parallelism) is explicit: memory 8*parallelism..4194304 KiB, iterations 1..1000, parallelism 1..255 (InvalidCryptoInput otherwise). PasswordHash.string() draws a fresh 16-byte salt from its Entropy on every observation, so two strings of one password differ. PasswordCheck accepts only "$argon2id$" strings; a malformed string is InvalidCryptoInput, a wrong password is false. outdated(policy) tells whether a stored hash used other parameters and should be rehashed.
